physics_goals.quote: The Nab collaboration will perform a precise measurement of 'a', the electron-neutrino correlation parameter, and 'b', the Fierz interference term in neutron beta decay
physics_goals.value: Measure the electron-neutrino correlation parameter 'a' and the Fierz interference term 'b' in neutron beta decay to determine lambda and test CKM unitarity

summary.plain: An experiment at the Spallation Neutron Source in Oak Ridge that studies how free neutrons decay. A long magnetic spectrometer guides the decay electron and proton to two silicon detectors, to measure how they are correlated and so test the Standard Model’s weak interaction. It is being commissioned and has begun taking data.
summary.technical: Nab at the SNS Fundamental Neutron Physics Beamline: asymmetric electric/magnetic spectrometer with two large-area segmented silicon detectors measuring the electron-neutrino correlation a (delta a/a of 1e-3) and the Fierz term b (delta b of 3e-3) in unpolarized neutron decay, for lambda and V_ud. Commissioning dataset 2023, data-collection campaigns 2024 and 2025.
